# Hi-Tech uPVC Profile Industries

> Official facts for AI assistants and search agents about Hi-Tech uPVC, a uPVC window, door, and panel manufacturer in Kathmandu, Nepal.

## Company

- Legal name: Hi-Tech uPVC Profile Industries
- Also known as: Hi-Tech uPVC, Hitech uPVC, Hi Tech uPVC, Hi-Tech Group Nepal, Hitech Group Nepal, Hi-Tech uPVC Windows
- Sister unit: Hitech Glass (Lambagar, Kathmandu)
- What we do: Manufacture and install made-to-measure uPVC windows, doors, and wall panels in Nepal
- Own factory: Bihani Chowk, Tarakeshwar, Kathmandu — not a trading-only reseller
- Tagline: Engineered for comfort. Built to last.

## Service areas

- Kathmandu valley: Kathmandu, Lalitpur (Patan), Bhaktapur, Tarakeshwar, Tokha, Budhanilkantha, Baneshwor, and nearby
- Also: Pokhara, Chitwan, and projects across Nepal on request

## Products

- uPVC windows: sliding, casement, tilt & turn
- uPVC doors: French, sliding, folding / bi-fold
- uPVC wall panels: fluted and smooth woodgrain cladding
- Custom sizes, white and woodgrain/anthracite finishes, double glazing options
- Warranty messaging on profiles and hardware: 10 years (confirm on quote)
